message: 大漁、一本釣り日誌

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa~~! No matter how you look at it, it's the ocean~~!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, hey, Lolotte! Running is dangerous--whoa.」
Why am I the one tripping over?

name: Lolotte
message: 「President. Are you all right?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm fine, probably.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So this is the ocean~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, is this your first time?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No! However, you might say that just being at the ocean makes me feel like a beginner all over again.」
Wanting to take in the sea breeze with her whole body, Lolotte spread both arms wide.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmm~~. The wind feels so wonderful.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, it really does. There's a delicious smell of fish in the air.」
Now then, the main event starts from here.
Just a little while ago.

name: Lolotte
message: 「President. Forgive me for asking something out of the blue, but what exactly is 'hot pot'?」

name: Synn
message: 「You put food inside a pot, simmer it until it's bubbling, and then everyone picks at it and eats together--wait, you don't know?」
Spoken like a true Western-style young lady.

name: Lolotte
message: 「It sounds like quite a mysterious dish. Incidentally, what sort of food does one put inside?」

name: Synn
message: 「Usually bounty from the sea and bounty from the mountains, I guess.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The sea, and the mountains?」

name: Synn
message: 「Like fish and vegetables.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, I see. So that is why people say 'a thousand in the sea, a thousand in the mountains'!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's totally different.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I have seen vegetables simmered in soups and such. However, fish...!」
Her eyes are sparkling so brightly they're practically dazzling.

name: Lolotte
message: 「A place where fish can be caught... Um...」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said earlier, the ocean, probably.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's go to the sea!」

name: Synn
message: 「Look, Lolotte. Surely you don't mean--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now, let's catch some fish!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, hold on!」
I hurriedly wrap my arms around her from behind to stop her in her tracks. She looks ready to dive straight into the ocean barehanded.

name: Synn
message: 「You need at least a fishing rod to catch anything.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A fishing rod?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aha, a tool for catching fish, is it? Something like a long stick... Oh! How about that one over there?」

name: Synn
message: 「No way, you can't just snap a branch off a park tree.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And here I thought we'd get a bite every cast...」
How does she even know a term like that when she doesn't even know what the ocean is?
A luxurious small boat pulls up to the shore.

name: Riesling
message: 「Hup!」
A woman in a tuxedo vaults nimbly over the guardrail, executes about three forward rolls, and sticks the landing.

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady. I was informed that you canceled your afternoon schedule today, yet...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I've come to procure food for the mixer!」

name: Riesling
message: 「And so to the sea you came. Milady, when it comes to offshore, deep-sea, or pier fishing, please leave everything to I, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa... How did she know we came here to fish?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nothing ever gets past you, Jiiya.」

name: Riesling
message: 「You flatter me.」
Smiling without a flicker of emotion, she hands a fishing rod to Lolotte.

name: Riesling
message: 「Since you're here, please make use of this red rod.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So I catch fish with this?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, right.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「All right. Let's do this!」
Holding the fishing rod in hand, she triumphantly rolls up her sleeves.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Fishing!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hyaaa!」
Smacked right in the face by the fishing rod, I crouch down on the spot.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aaah! Mr. President, I'm so sorry!」

name: Synn
message: 「A fishing rod isn't something you swing around like that.」
I borrow the fishing rod from a frowning Lolotte.

name: Synn
message: 「Amazing. It actually has a proper lure and reel attached.」
It bends nicely even with just a light flick. It's probably a top-notch fishing rod.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright. Here goes the first cast.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Lord President. Let us drop the rig as close to the quay wall as possible.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, ah, yes.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see! So that's how you do it.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Let us shake the rig in small, vigorous movements. Up and down--」

name: Riesling
message: 「Like this! Like this!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Just like so.」

name: Synn
message: 「Understood.」
I try mimicking Riesling-san's movements by watching and copying her.

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!?」
A bite already. Weight starts pulling on the rod.

name: Lolotte
message: 「W-what's wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「I might have caught one already.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehh, really!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Mr. President, point your rod offshore and reel it in all at once.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Reel it in steadily. Never let the line go slack.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's barely moving though... Am I snagged on something?」

name: Riesling
message: 「No. There is a faint tug. Don't give up and keep pulling with all your strength.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, you can do it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ngh, mmgh... Yah!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Fight!」

name: Synn
message: 「All right! I caught something!」
Reeled in onto the shore was an eight-legged mollusk.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wh-!? Wh-wh-what is this?! It's squirming!」
She was intensely curious about the catch, yet retreated far into the distance. It was certainly scary if it was your first time seeing one.

name: Synn
message: 「Is this... an octopus?」
First, a raw octopus obtained.
Y-You can actually catch octopuses here?!

name: Lolotte
message: 「An octopus... octopus... Um, let's see--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oho! You mean the sausage in bento boxes?」
She wasn't entirely wrong.

name: Paqy
message: 「Let's see here, let me take a look at this so-called octopus Synn-sama caught.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're pitch black, Mr. Panda.」
He was practically a black bear now.

name: Lolotte
message: 「So this is fish catching! I get it now! I'm all set! Leave the rest to me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, good luck~!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How exciting. I wonder what I'll catch!」
Faithfully following what I had done, she cast her first line.
Huh. Come to think of it, I didn't see Riesling anywhere.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, it feels kind of heavy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「S-S-S-S-S-Something's on the line!」

name: Synn
message: 「Already?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Kyaaaah!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Lolotte!」
I frantically cling to Lolotte's body as she's being dragged away.

name: Synn
message: 「Aaah, sorry!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A-At this rate, we're heading straight into the sea...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!」
You're so soft, Lolotte--no, no, stop that! This is definitely not the time!

name: Synn
message: 「Let go of it, Lolotte!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「T-That is the one thing I absolutely refuse to do!」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To make the social gathering a success, I absolutely... cannot let go!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ngh, fine! If you're that determined, then I'll--」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaaaah!」
I drop my hips and brace myself over Lolotte, digging my heels in, but it's no use at all!

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ngggggh, I won't lose!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, reel it in, quick!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-It's no good~~! It won't budge at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaaah, the sea is right there?!」
The day we return to seafoam has finally come. Just then, however--

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave Milady's safety to me, Riesling Tooyama.」
Out of nowhere, Riesling-san appeared, drenched from head to toe.
She swiftly drew a rifle from within her coat--
And fired several shots toward the sea.
Then came a thick rope she happened to have on hand, with a large harpoon attached to the end.
Riesling-san powerfully hurled that harpoon toward the buoy.
Perhaps feeling a tug, he slowly began pulling the rope. As he did, the strain on our end steadily eased up.

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then, Milady.」
Matching our breathing, we hauled it up together.

name: Synn
message: 「Th... This is...?」

name: Riesling
message: 「It appears to be a bluefin tuna.」
The harpoon had pierced straight through the giant body's belly. What destructive power.

name: Synn
message: 「This is a tuna!? H-How huge is this thing.」

name: Paqy
message: 「The damn thing's frozen solid...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Th... This is a fish...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We did it... We did it, President! We actually caught a fish!」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank goodness. Thank goodness for real!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Congratulations, Milady.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is amazing! Now the social gathering will go off without a hitch!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a tuna, a tuna! It's my first time seeing one! That settles it--seafood hot pot it is!」
Without caring about the eyes around us, we hugged each other and shared in the joy.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, butler over there. Isn't this a bit...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please call me Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I don't think spoiling them too much is a good idea.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Catching it was purely the result of their own hard work. One can give up at any time.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, fair enough.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What a massive caaatch!」

name: Synn
message: 「Toro, it's toro! The fatty otoro I've always dreamed oooof!」
